abilities.name: Fist of Conviction
abilities.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to 1% of Gepard's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Daunting Smite
abilities.text:
Deals Ice DMG equal to 2% of Gepard's ATK to a single enemy, with a 0.65% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Additional Ice DMG equal to 0.6% of Gepard's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

abilities.name: Enduring Bulwark
abilities.text: Applies a Shield to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to 0.45% of Gepard's DEF plus 600 for 3 turn(s).

abilities.name: Unyielding Will
abilities.text: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming knocked down, Gepard's HP immediately restores to 0.5% of his Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

abilities.name: Comradery
abilities.text: After Gepard uses his Technique, when the next battle begins, a Shield will be applied to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to 0.24% of Gepard's DEF plus 150 for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Integrity
abilities.desc: Gepard has a higher chance to be attacked by enemies.

abilities.name: Commander
abilities.desc: When Unyielding Will is triggered, Gepard's Energy will be restored to 100%.

abilities.name: Fighting Spirit
abilities.desc: Gepard's ATK increases by 35% of his current DEF. This effect will refresh at the start of each turn.

abilities.name: Due Diligence
abilities.desc: Base chance for Gepard's Skill to Freeze enemies increases by 35%.

abilities.name: Lingering Cold
abilities.desc: After an enemy Frozen by Gepard's Skill is unfrozen, their SPD is reduced by 20% for 1 turn(s).

abilities.name: Never Surrender
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Faith Moves Mountains
abilities.desc: When Gepard is in battle, all allies' Effect RES increases by 20%.

abilities.name: Cold Iron Fist
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1. up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Unyielding Determination
abilities.desc: When his Talent is triggered, Gepard's action is Advanced Forward by 100%, and he restores extra HP equal to 50% of his Max HP.
